title: Snazzie FM News: The Final Score
description: Dale and Marsha read the sports desk at the top of the hour: a forfeit by fog, a scoreboard that now reports every game as one steady green light, and champions who cannot stop reporting for their parade.

lines.speaker: news-dale
lines.text: Top of the hour. This is Snazzie F M News, the sports desk. I'm Dale Crisp.

lines.speaker: news-marsha
lines.text: And I'm Marsha Veld. Our top story tonight, the Civic League title game.

lines.speaker: news-dale
lines.text: Final score, seven to nothing. The visiting team's bus took the on-ramp into the fog at halftime and has not been heard from since.

lines.speaker: news-marsha
lines.text: The league is recording it as a forfeit, and, in their words, a learning experience.

lines.speaker: news-dale
lines.text: We'll have an update on the away side as it develops, Marsha.

lines.speaker: news-marsha
lines.text: Of course, Dale. The fog has offered to cover their travel expenses, so the families are said to be comfortable.

lines.speaker: news-dale
lines.text: Over at GreenFlow Stadium, the scoreboard ran out of approved green pixels in the third quarter.

lines.speaker: news-marsha
lines.text: It now displays every score as a single steady green light. The home crowd has agreed that counts as a win.

lines.speaker: news-dale
lines.text: Still no word from the visiting bus, for those following at home.

lines.speaker: news-marsha
lines.text: And finally, last season's champions have now reported for their victory parade ninety mornings running, as required.

lines.speaker: news-dale
lines.text: They may go home the moment someone locates the form that lets them stop. <p:0.3> We'll have that form for you, hopefully, after the break.
